Israel and U.S. officials saw hard-liner former President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad
as the potential future leader of Iran,
[the](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/19/us/politics/iran-israel-us-leader-
ahmadinejad.html) _[New York
Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/19/us/politics/iran-israel-us-leader-
ahmadinejad.html)_ reported this week.

That's supposedly why Israel bombed his home in the early days of their
illegal war on Iran - to free him from house arrest. But instead, he was
injured, and, according to the _Times,_ became "disillusioned with the regime
change plan" that had been discussed with him prior to the strikes.

He hasn't been seen in public since.

Here are seven things you should know about the man the U.S. and Israel wanted
back in power in Tehran:

### **1\. Holocaust Denier**

Ahmadinejad has repeatedly denied the Holocaust, including [calling
it](https://www.reuters.com/article/business/change-suite/iran-president-says-
holocaust-pretext-to-form-israel-idUSTRE58H1BL/) "a lie based on an unprovable
and mythical claim" during a 2009 speech in Iran. The week after that speech,
in an interview with
[NPR,](https://www.npr.org/2009/09/25/113171156/ahmadinejad-holocaust-opinion-
of-just-a-few) he called accounts of Holocaust survivors "claims," asking,
"Why should everyone be forced to accept the opinion of just a few on a
historic event?"

### **2\. Accused by Israel of Wanting to Destroy Israel**

Many know Ahmadinejad as the man who called for Israel to be "wiped off the
map," a statement that has gotten him countless comparisons to Hitler. The
only issue is that he has [never](https://www.juancole.com/2006/05/bill-scher-
importance-of-cole-v.html) said that. A more accurate translation of the
remarks would be "[this regime occupying Jerusalem must vanish from the page
of time,](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2006/jun/02/comment.usa)"
a quote from the late Ayatollah Khomeini.

### **3\. Pro-Death Penalty for LGBTQ People**

While [speaking](https://worldleaders.columbia.edu/content/president-mahmoud-
ahmadinejad-islamic-republic-iran) at a Columbia University World Leaders
forum in 2007, Ahmadinejad falsely [claimed
](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUE0tukdr4c)that there are no gay people in
Iran. During the event, he was also asked about the use of the death penalty,
including for gay people, to which he responded, "Don't you have capital
punishment in the United States? You do too. In Iran, too, there is capital
punishment."

### **4\. Allowed Women to Attend Soccer Games**

In 2006, Ahmadinejad [lifted
](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2006/apr/25/iran.gender)a ban that had
blocked women from attending soccer games, saying, "The presence of women and
families in public places promotes chastity." The move was met with criticism
from the hard-line Iranians who helped get Ahmadinejad elected.

### **5\. Barred From Running in Elections 3 Times**

Since the end of his presidency in 2013, Ahmadinejad has [attempted
](https://www.cnn.com/world/middleeast/mahmoud-ahmadinejad-fast-facts)to run
for reelection three times: in 2017, 2021, and 2023, but each time the Iranian
Guardian Council barred him from running.

### **6\. Apparently Loves Michigan Football**

The former Iranian president had an active Twitter account from 2017 to 2022,
where he posted about, among other things, American football. Ohio State
Buckeye fans won't be pleased to know Trump's pick for the next president of
Iran is a Michigan Wolverines football supporter. In 2018, Ahmadinejad
tweeted, ["With a hard work ethic Inshallah the U of M will return to its
glory
days."](https://x.com/ahmadinejad1956/status/1052178368072945668?s=46&t=nRhlMm7BLXnE72OzMKa4Ow)

### **7\. Apparently Loves Tupac, Too**

During his Twitter era, Ahmadinejad also posted [Happy Birthday to the
"legend" Tupac
Shakur](https://x.com/Ahmadinejad1956/status/1405232180981338114?s=20) on what
would have been the rapper's 50th birthday. The post ends with the lyrics,
"Cause any day they'll push the button and all come in like Malcolm X or Bobby
Hutton," from Shakur's 2004 hit "Ghetto Gospel."
